[[Ogre]]s can be assigned as a [[Slayer task]] at level 40 [[combat]] by [[Vannaka]]. Ogres are most commonly found in [[Kandarin]].

Along with ogres and [[Ogress Warrior|ogress warrior]]s and [[Ogress Shaman|shamans]], [[mogre]]s, [[zogre]]s, and [[skogre]]s can be killed to satisfy the task. [[Jogre]]s do '''not''' count towards the task.

While zogres and skogres both have a lower combat level than the rest, players should still take caution, as they are capable of inflicting [[disease]].

Players with level 41 [[Magic]] can use [[ensouled ogre head]]s to cast [[Adept Reanimation]] and kill [[reanimated ogre]]s.
